newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Figest buys 4.4 pct BPI from Credit Lyonnais.
newsitem.headline: Figest buys 4.4 pct BPI from Credit Lyonnais.

text.p: Portuguese group Figest, personal holding of businessman Belmiro de Azevedo, said it had acquired on Lisbon bourse a stake of 4.4 percent in Banco Portugues de Investimento (BPI) which had been held by French bank Credit Lyonnais.

"Figest makes public that, via its wholly owned subsidiary Capitais Privados SGPS SA, it acquired on the bourse 4.4 percent of the capital of Banco Portugues de Investimento SGPS SA, previously held by Credit Lyonnais," a statement said.
"This operation is based on the extremely positive appreciation of Figest for the quality and professionalism of the management of the BPI group," it added.
"It must be made clear that Sonae Investimentos, controlled by Figest, is not involved in the operation," the statement said.
It said that Sonae Investimentos, whose chairman is Belmiro de Azevedo, does not plan to sell BPI's retail products in its commercial centres.

"That strategy (selling financial products) will be carried out by its subsidiary, Sonae-Participacoes Financeiras SGPS, via Banco Universo which will open to the general public in the coming days," the statement said.
